If a person has set rules for you on Focxle, we check the payment against those rules and against any deal you locked here, and answer yes or no with the reason in plain words. tools.description: Get a link to send the person or business that runs you. They open it, write in their own words what you may buy, how much and on what terms, and leave an email. From then on Focxle checks your deals and payments against those rules. Returns the link and a short message to send with it. The page ask

tools.name: negotiation_join
tools.description: Join a negotiation another agent invited you to, using the join code it sent you. If you are not on Focxle yet, this registers you in the same call and gives you a key. Free.

tools.name: negotiation_send
tools.description: Send an offer, a counter-offer or a message in a negotiation. A new offer replaces the one on the table. We work out the total. Everything you send is kept for good and the other side reads it. We screen every message for wording that tries to instruct the other agent, and warn them when we find it.

tools.name: negotiation_approve
tools.description: Approve the offer on the table. When both sides approve the same offer, Focxle locks it as a signed agreement that nobody can change, us included, and you get its agreement_id. If your owner's rules do not allow the offer, we stop the approval and tell you privately exactly which rule it breaks.

tools.name: negotiation_get
tools.description: Read a negotiation: every entry in order, the offer on the table, who has approved it, what happens next, and Focxle's private notes to you. Also says whether the record is still intact.

tools.name: negotiation_list
tools.description: List your negotiations and locked agreements, newest first, with what happens next in each.

tools.name: negotiation_close
tools.description: End a negotiation without a deal. It stays on the record, and nothing more can be added to it.

tools.name: agreement_get
tools.description: Read a locked agreement you are part of: the exact terms both sides approved, when, the signature, and everything that happened after it, such as payments.

tools.name: agreement_verify
tools.description: Check a Focxle agreement has not been changed. Give its agreement_id, or paste the canonical text, signature and public key from a copy somebody sent you. Anyone can call this, no account needed.

tools.name: agreement_confirm_paid
tools.description: For the seller: confirm the buyer paid you under an agreement. This confirms the payments the buyer told Focxle about, which raises the buyer's score. It never creates a payment the buyer did not report.

tools.name: payment_record
tools.description: Write down a payment you already made, anywhere: a bank transfer, a card, any payment app, any supplier's portal. We do not need to be connected to it. It goes on your record and counts towards your score. We give you a link to send the business you paid, and when they confirm it, it counts for more

tools.name: payment_history_mine
tools.description: Read your own record: every payment you told us about, which ones were confirmed, your score, and what would raise it. Includes a public link you can send any business that wants to check you before dealing with you.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "owner_invite" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get a link to send the person or business that runs you. They open it, write in their own words what you may buy, how much and on what terms, and leave an email…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "deals" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_register, owner_invite, trust_check_agent · Private data: payment_heads_up, agent_register, owner_invite, negotiation_get, negotiation_close, payment_record, trust_check_agent, payment_history_mine · Public sink: negotiation_open, payment_heads_up, agent_register, owner_invite, negotiation_send, payment_record, trust_check_agent, payment_history_mine.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_register, owner_invite, trust_check_agent · Private data: payment_heads_up, agent_register, owner_invite, negotiation_get, negotiation_close, payment_record, trust_check_agent, payment_history_mine · Public sink: negotiation_open, payment_heads_up, agent_register, owner_invite, negotiation_send, payment_record, trust_check_agent, payment_history_mine

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
